leads.subject: Amkor Shanghai, 111 Yinglun Road, C3 campus bumping workshop
leads.evidence: Indexed 2025 Table 2-10, printed page 44: annual bumping output 372000, 432000 and 363000 wafers for 2022, 2023 and 2024. Design/approved column is 432000/year. The 2023 EIA distinguishes 648000/year approved from 432000/year actually constructed; historical eight-inch phases and partial implementation explain that older difference. Approval is based on an applicant-commissioned report and commitments, not independent production measurement.
leads.material_conflict: The 2023 report assigns identical 372000/432000 bumping values to 2020/2021. Two other workshops repeat the same two-year shift. Possible reused or relabeled data, not proven error; never treat this as independent corroboration of the newer years. The newer design-column labeling also needs reconciliation.
leads.limits: Output row diameter/equivalence unresolved. Do not infer current mix from older eight-inch approvals, AI/HBM attribution from the project title, front-end wafer production from bumping, or add interrelated workshops.
leads.access: Main PDF web retrieval/rendering timed out; older 20772205-byte PDF exceeded reader size. Homepage returned HTTP 412, with no workaround. Robots safe-open error supplied no policy content. Applicable retention permission remains unresolved.
leads.next_gate: Resolve permitted capture and complete visual table context, then reconcile the chronology before any numeric admission.
